intent: Record as reviewed rules five admission, quota, reassignment and incident behaviors of a Run that the code enforces and tests but the Registry did not hold.
observable_outcome: get-context run returns the five rules as reviewed, each citing the enforcing code.

acceptance_criteria.statement: A Run past the Workspace's concurrency limit is refused with workspace_concurrency.
Platform, provider, capability, policy and resource-limit failures do not count against the quota.
A Workspace that cannot reserve the run budget is refused with credit_balance.
A second lost provider ends the Run failed with provider_error.
Cleanup under an incident halt on the attempt's provider destroys nothing.
The approval that makes the records reviewed is checkable outside the package.
